enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Accuracy +10: Passive: +10 Insight bonus to attack rolls
Insightful Deadly +5: +5 Insight bonus to weapon damage.
Sonic Absorption +37%: Passive: 37% Enhancement Bonus to Sonic Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
